summary: Iteration 22: Tested 'Dono de Assessoria' feature on /cadastro page. All 8 features verified working: (1) Section 'Você é Dono de Uma Assessoria/Equipe?' appears when INDIVIDUAL selected, (2) Section has orange background (bg-orange-100), (3) SIM/NÃO buttons with correct data-testid, (4) After SIM: fields appear (Nome, Estado, Cidade, Foto, BIO), (5) After NÃO: fields hidden, (6) BIO has maxLength=200, (7) POST /api/auth/register with is_dono_assessoria=true creates assessoria, (8) User gets role='dono_assessoria' and equipe=assessoria name.
seed_data_creation: Created multiple TEST_ prefixed assessorias during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dono de Assessoria feature on cadastro page is fully functional. When INDIVIDUAL is selected, an orange section appears asking if user owns an assessoria. Clicking SIM shows fields: Nome da Assessoria, Estado, Cidade, Foto (optional), Mensagem da BIO (max 200 chars). Clicking NÃO hides these fields. Backend correctly creates assessoria on registration with is_dono_assessoria=true, sets user role to 'dono_assessoria', and equipe to assessoria name.
